description: One synced capture from BucketLog: a photo of a picked bucket, scored by an on-device ML model, at a place and a time, against whoever's badge was scanned. verdict=Accepted is the one fact that turns a capture into piece work — entries_to_payroll_shape (bucket_bridge.py) and payroll_integration.py's _piece_units_for are what a Rejected capture never reaches. company/worker_badge/employee/timestamp/verdict arrive from the device; shift, synced_at and status are filled in on this side as the record moves from synced, to linked to a shift, to paid.

fields.description: The series a Bucket Log Entry is named from, expanded by the controller (year is the capture's own timestamp year, not the sync date) so a docname is the same shape on a bench and in the standalone suite — BLE-2026-0001.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The iOS BucketLogEntry's own UUID. sync_bucket_entries deduplicates a sync batch by this field — resending an entry ERPNext already has is a no-op, not a duplicate record.
fields.label: Entry UUID

fields.description: The iOS session this capture belongs to — groups entries the same way Bucket Log Session does, before or independent of that record existing.
fields.label: Session UUID

fields.description: Which company this capture belongs to — the same field get_piecework_summary and reconcile_bucket_payroll scope by.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: What the on-device model decided. Accepted is the only verdict entries_to_payroll_shape turns into a paid unit — a Rejected capture is the model saying the bucket was not actually filled.
fields.label: Verdict

fields.description: The QR badge ID scanned on-device. Resolved to employee via link_badge_to_employee's Bucket Log Badge Map register; kept even after resolution as the device's own record of what was scanned.
fields.label: Worker Badge

fields.description: Who picked this bucket, resolved from worker_badge. Nullable until link_badge_to_employee has mapped this badge, or the badge was never mapped at all — an entry with no employee earns nothing (see entries_to_payroll_shape) until this is filled in.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: When the bucket was captured on-device — the fact payroll cares about, not when ERPNext received it (see synced_at).
fields.label: Timestamp

fields.description: The ML model's own fill-coverage score for this bucket, 0-100.
fields.label: Coverage %

fields.description: Which ML Model (by source_uuid, joining to model_registry.py's ML Model.source_uuid) produced this verdict — the same UUID Volume Vision and get_active_model's manifest use.
fields.label: Model UUID

fields.description: v0.68.0. Which Container Fill Threshold row this entry is checked against — 'cherry_bucket', 'pear_bin', or any other value the device and the foreman have agreed on. Blank on an entry synced before this field existed, or from a device that does not send it: get_fill_determination reports coverage_percent alone in that case rather than refusing.
fields.label: Container Type

fields.description: v0.68.0. The segmentation model's pixel count for the product (fruit) mask — the numerator get_fill_determination divides by container_area_px to show its work. Diagnostic, same as coverage_percent: never an input to pay.
fields.label: Mask Area (px)

fields.description: v0.68.0. The segmentation model's pixel count for the container's own boundary — the denominator. Zero or blank means get_fill_determination cannot recompute a percentage from areas and falls back to coverage_percent.
fields.label: Container Area (px)

fields.description: FSMA 21 CFR 1 Subpart S; MSPA crew records. The crew a hygiene training record, a field sanitation inspection and a wage-law jurisdiction all attach to.
fields.label: Crew

fields.description: FSMA Subpart S critical tracking event; spray REI/PHI linkage. The join to the spray record — how a residue question becomes an answerable question.
fields.label: Block

fields.description: FSMA Subpart S — commingling/transformation event. Where buckets from several pickers become one lot.
fields.label: Bin

fields.description: FSMA Subpart S — shipping event. Closes the chain of custody a buyer's mock recall is timed against.
fields.label: Shipment

fields.description: The H3 cell this capture fell in, at whatever resolution BucketLog logs — the same indexing the geospatial field/zone tools use, so a bucket count and a field boundary can be joined without a spatial query.
fields.label: H3 Cell

fields.description: The device this capture came from, as BucketLog identifies itself — not an ERPNext identity.
fields.label: Device ID

fields.description: The Farm Shift this bucket has been attributed to for payroll, set by link_entries_to_shift. Empty until then.
fields.label: Shift

fields.description: Pending is synced and unlinked. Linked carries a shift. Paid has appeared on a payroll slip. Moves forward only — link_entries_to_shift never moves an entry out of Paid.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When ERPNext received this record via sync_bucket_entries — distinct from timestamp, which is when the bucket was actually picked.
fields.label: Synced At

name: Bucket Log Entry
